screens.question: What is the aggregate operational health and where does attention sit?

cards.rule: count unique chain IDs with confirmed attention evidence; planning-only rows excluded
accepted report evidence and Flight Date + 1 deadline; missing dates are deadline_unknown
deduplicate by chain and retain blocked, late, missing-evidence, unresolved-lineage, and stale states
executed_flights / planned_flights; show numerator and denominator; zero denominator is no_data

screens.question: Where does Plan → Execution → Processing/QA → Report → Client-ready break?

cards.rule: edges require explicit relation IDs; missing edges are unresolved lineage
return source_count, confirmed_handoff_count, exception_count, missing_evidence_count
review queue only; never convert review count into performance

screens.question: What is the aggregate approved crew presence state?

cards.rule: use explicit Availability and active directory state; blank is awaiting_confirmation
aggregate approved team context only; no work-count inference
show current/stale/unavailable/needs_review visibly

screens.question: What is happening across approved operating regions?

cards.rule: region/site aggregates require explicit relations; location text alone is insufficient
accepted completion and report evidence only
aggregate confirmed blocker/incident/review states only

screens.question: What is the reporting cadence and outcome state?

cards.rule: authoritative Flight Operations Scheduled Date and Report Submission dates
Submission Status Done plus accepted report evidence
deadline is Flight Date + 1 calendar day; missing dates are review
missing/late/review records only; deduplicate by report item and explicit relation

screens.question: Which aggregate inventory assets are ready, held, or in review?

cards.rule: Good/operational plus no blocking evidence is ready; blank condition is review
reconcile operational, Needs Maintenance, Out of Service, and review to unique source item IDs
show V2/V3 only when explicit model/version field or approved Type/model normalization exists; never infer from partial names
Needs Maintenance and Out of Service are exact source conditions; incident failure requires incident evidence
